weights = []

        v = rec['values']
        products.append(v['ProductName'])
        values.append(int(v['Value']))
        weights.append(int(v['Weight']))
    elif rec['source'].endswith('capacity.csv'):
        if 'Capacity' in rec['values']:
            capacity = int(rec['values']['Capacity'])

    raise ValueError('Mismatch in products, values, or weights length.')
if capacity is None:
    raise ValueError('Capacity not found in LEGACY_RECORDS.')
n = len(products)
m = gp.Model('CarSales_Inventory')
x_vars = m.addVars(products, lb=0, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='')
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((values[i] * x_vars[products[i]] for i in range(n))), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((weights[i] * x_vars[products[i]] for i in range(n))) <= capacity, name='capacity')
m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
m.optimize()
if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
    for v in x_vars.values():
        print(f'{v.VarName}: {v.X}')
else:
